title: SceneWorks catalog memory guidance
description: The `memoryGuidance` object the API serves on every model catalog row (SW-7032, `sceneworks_core::memory_guidance`). Every value is host-independent: each threshold is the minimum host memory (GB, base 1024^3; unified memory on the MLX lane, dedicated VRAM on the Candle lane) at which the client's own host probe satisfies the API's fit rule. A null threshold means no basis to predict, which the client treats as fitting. The web holds no memory policy of its own; it compares these values with its host probe and selects the rows of the tiers it has installed.

resolutionThresholds.description: Declared `limits.resolutions` buckets above the 1536x1536 baseline that have a prediction, mapped to their minimum host GB. A bucket that is absent always fits.

suggestion.description: The declared quant tiers in fidelity order (highest first) with each tier's fit threshold. The suggestion is the first tier whose threshold the host meets, else the last.

tiers.description: Per tier key (every variant, runtime quant tier, convert-output tier and lane per-tier evidence row).

minHostGb.description: Fit threshold for this variant (present for variant rows only).

installedHostGb.description: Host GB this tier contributes to an installed set's requirement: its own lane evidence, the Candle q8 proxy for a candle-only tier, or the MLX estimate.

installedEstimated.description: True when installedHostGb is a proxy or an estimate rather than the tier's own lane evidence; the blanket floor then still applies.

floorGb.description: The lane's declared floor for this tier (its per-tier row, else the scalar).

measuredHostGb.description: Host GB of the tier's own measured lane peak, the basis of a not-installed entry floor.

entryFloorGb.description: The lane's declared floor for the lightest installable tier.

uncalibrated.description: The lane flags its numbers uncalibrated (`candle.measured: false`).

endpointEstimate.description: Candle only: the packaged measured SDXL endpoint guidance for its one measured tier.
